subject.title: [Proposal] Simplify Model Configuration: Single-Source Reconcile + Session Override Reset

question: Should OpenClaw add an official model/session reconcile-reset surface, and should it report only by default or also clear explicit session, agent, provider, generated catalog, and auth pins under scoped flags?
rationale: The requested commands would inspect and potentially mutate persisted model, provider, generated catalog, session, and auth-profile state, so source inspection cannot safely choose compatibility semantics.

options.title: Report-first reconcile and scoped reset
options.body: Add dry-run/report-first commands that preserve explicit pins by default and require narrow flags for clearing persisted selections.

options.title: Diagnostics and doctor only
options.body: Keep runtime precedence unchanged and improve status, doctor, and config validation warnings for shadowed or invalid model refs.

options.title: Automatic precedence change
options.body: Automatically clear or override existing pins when defaults change, accepting deliberate compatibility risk for durable session or agent selections.

recommendation.title: Report-first reconcile and scoped reset
recommendation.body: Add dry-run/report-first commands that preserve explicit pins by default and require narrow flags for clearing persisted selections.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the broadest observed history across the model config, auth profile, CLI, and status surfaces involved in the product decision.
